decisions.evidence: Independently reviewed the current producer full proof, all declared prerequisite statements, its contract and manifest. The face-dual, trace, patch Poincare and affine-approximation arguments establish the claimed interpolant and meet the consumer's d=2,3, matching shape-regular mesh, H0 and Countable Choice hypotheses. The observed producer bytes are still current. Guermond chap49.pdf p.1 is only Chapter 49 on mixed-form well-posedness; Boffi–Brezzi–Fortin Theorem 5.2.2, printed p.276 (PDF p.288), is a saddle-point error estimate and §8.4.2 is the MINI element. Thus the inaccurate locators are confirmed nonfatal, with no mathematical repair needed in the consumer. The single nonfatal-recorded ledger row records the finding, not a citation fix. Producer citation/manifest correction is escalated to owner/batch 31 outside this edit scope; no producer acceptance or repaired source is claimed.
